factors.O0: Core plane order from source-loaded StadiumReference2D.
factors.O1: Node Classic HBS order: outer bottom, outer top, outer left, outer right, ball-area bottom, ball-area top.
factors.P0: Source profile current plane bCoef values: outer=0.1, area=1.
factors.P1: Node HBS effective plane bCoef values: all four outer=0; ball-area effective value=1.
factors.T0: Core adaptive substeps: move fraction of tick then resolve each substep; damping/gravity once after all substeps.
factors.T1: Diagnostic full-tick sequencing: move position one full tick and apply gravity/damping before one contact pass. This is an explicit Core clone variant, not Node semantic equivalence.
